Change c0063. Location: 1818 Vol. I, Ch. II; 1831 Ch. III.

Context before (unchanged): My mother was dead, but we had still duties which we ought to perform; we must continue our course with the rest, and learn to think ourselves fortunate, whilst one remains whom the spoiler has not seized.

1818 text: My journey to Ingolstadt, which had been deferred by these events, was now again determined upon.

1831 text: My departure for Ingolstadt, which had been deferred by these events, was now again determined upon.

Diff: My [-journey to-] {+departure for+} Ingolstadt, which had been deferred by these events, was now again determined upon.

Context after (unchanged): I obtained from my father a respite of some weeks.

result.rationale: "journey to" becomes "departure for" Ingolstadt; a synonymous phrasing that keeps the same event (the postponed trip to university) and has no interpretive effect.
